newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - June 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* Sun Hung Kai Securities said it expected the market to continue moving sideways on persistently low volume.

* "The lack of news to propel stocks higher will move market players to cash in on their gains while they try to accumulate and look for new buying opportunities on the market's correction," BPI Securities said in an advisory to clients.
* BPI Securities recommended a buy on consumer stocks on prospects of a recovery in the second quarter of the year.
* On Monday, the Philippine composite index dropped 10.75 points to 2,790.86.
* Sun Hung Kai pegged market resistance at the 2,850 level.
